about: Lane E2-FIX2B: the history import's digest 0 (tx::migrate -> digest0Answer -> askRung) is reachable from tg_poll, so the cycle RB-E2-DEV.json declares for the turn's climb (a summarizer exchange carries no climb of the turn) is now also met from the summarizer's side.

impossible_cycles.why: plain_compact.cpp: askRung's exchange (runExchange) is the summarizer's and carries no ClimbAsk of a turn (plain_compact.cpp never sets ExchangeRequest::climb), so the turn's compactFirst, and through it CompactDriver::ask, is never re-entered from it
